messages.body:
## Банк "Кузнецкий" — Company.id 4469

Catalog metadata (unchanged):

```json
{
  "countryCode": "RU",
  "fullTitle": null,
  "id": 4469,
  "title": "\u0411\u0430\u043d\u043a \"\u041a\u0443\u0437\u043d\u0435\u0446\u043a\u0438\u0439\"",
  "url": "kuzbank.ru"
}
```

Frozen base commit: `fe29fbc1291b8842ed201261408a3bc690875b55`. Checked: `2026-10-02T17:41:31.995464Z`.

### Exact versions and source

- No existing icon.svg at frozen base commit; this is the first icon addition.
- Fetched source SVG: [source.svg](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/bcbbe6d9ba46dc297a11fef8900bfa743c0be941/review-materials/4469/source.svg) — SHA-256 `d7ae3c88a17305c387404446fd41657eb954618c92e3f30f63034de29736a705`.
- Proposed final SVG: [final.svg](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/bcbbe6d9ba46dc297a11fef8900bfa743c0be941/review-materials/4469/final.svg) — SHA-256 `e13a4e0cca1f9c4f5e47456dfa2455a5066b92ea701274fe4ad0ec4084a02c3b`.
- Generated VectorDrawable XML: [final.xml](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/bcbbe6d9ba46dc297a11fef8900bfa743c0be941/review-materials/4469/final.xml) — SHA-256 `1c74b6cd95dc8b013b661470ceeaca8b06d9abd37cc11c97f4ec66be921a2649`.
- Exact base-to-final changes: [candidate.diff](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/bcbbe6d9ba46dc297a11fef8900bfa743c0be941/review-materials/4469/candidate.diff).
- Source page: [https://kuzbank.ru/local/templates/waydev\_kuzbank/img/logo\_kuzbank\_without\_35.svg](https://kuzbank.ru/local/templates/waydev_kuzbank/img/logo_kuzbank_without_35.svg).
- Source asset: [https://kuzbank.ru/local/templates/waydev\_kuzbank/img/logo\_kuzbank\_without\_35.svg](https://kuzbank.ru/local/templates/waydev_kuzbank/img/logo_kuzbank_without_35.svg).

### Evidence and judgment

- official checked 2026-10-02T17:21:30Z: [https://kuzbank.ru/local/templates/waydev\_kuzbank/img/logo\_kuzbank\_without\_35.svg](https://kuzbank.ru/local/templates/waydev_kuzbank/img/logo_kuzbank_without_35.svg); asset [https://kuzbank.ru/local/templates/waydev\_kuzbank/img/logo\_kuzbank\_without\_35.svg](https://kuzbank.ru/local/templates/waydev_kuzbank/img/logo_kuzbank_without_35.svg). Original vector served from the bank's own site template; pure vector paths with no text or embedded images. (independence group: official).
- third-party checked 2026-10-02T17:19:00Z: [https://www.cbr.ru/finorg/foinfo/?ogrn=1125800000094](https://www.cbr.ru/finorg/foinfo/?ogrn=1125800000094). registry card lists bank as active with base license 609 (independence group: cbr-registry).
- Independent evidence: primary official source; cbr.ru registry used as independent confirmation of identity/currency.
- Identity: confirmed — The selected SVG is served from the official site's own template assets and is referenced as the only logo image on the official pages..
- Currency: confirmed — The Bank of Russia registry card for the bank \(license 609\) lists it as active, and the bank's own contacts and details pages were live on the check date..
- Variant: confirmed — Template asset is named as the standard mark without the 35th-anniversary lockup; an alternate lockup is also live. The standard everyday variant was selected..
- Uncertainty: The site root rejects a plain command-line user agent, while the template asset endpoint itself answered normally over HTTPS..

Rationale: The official current logo exists only as a wordmark lockup; the catalog excludes accompanying bank-name text, so the standalone emblem from the same official vector is used as the application mark..
Role: Standalone emblem selected from the official wordmark lockup; bank-name text excluded per catalog suitability rules.; variant: standard everyday emblem from the live site template \(logo\_kuzbank\_without\_35.svg\); no anniversary lockup, no circular avatar observation — circle is a catalog plain-field adaptation, not an official circular asset.
Visible difference: First addition: no icon.svg existed at the frozen base commit; the change is absence -\> real catalog icon derived from the official vector..
Details: All four emblem paths \(fan mark, middle blade, right blade, pedestal bar\) are verbatim source geometry; color #069347 unchanged; internal white gaps and pedestal separation preserved; no strokes dropped.. Proportions: Whole emblem \(26.07x29.86 source units incl. pedestal\) uniformly scaled 0.75 and centered on a 34-unit white catalog circle; maximum emblem corner radius ~14.9 of 17, no clipping; recognizable at 48/96 px on both themes, solid shapes survive small sizes..

Source-to-final transformations:
- select the four emblem paths \(x\<=26.07\) from the official 210x34 lockup vector; wordmark text paths excluded
- remove the plain white full-canvas rect; add same-color \(#ffffff\) circular backing r=17 on a 34x34 canvas with transparency outside \(catalog plain-field adaptation\)
- uniform scale 0.75 and translate of the whole emblem: translate\(7.224,4.535\) scale\(0.75\), centered, no rotation/crop/recolor
- SVGO 4.1.0 with frozen config sha256 f2a406e05dd8849e35cd5d2ce96862b6e160b135135064ceafd64efd126f477e: 638 -\> 397 bytes; selected optimized \(trial-produced, visually identical under rsvg at 48/96/272 px\)

### Light and dark first icon addition

![First icon addition — light background](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/bcbbe6d9ba46dc297a11fef8900bfa743c0be941/review-materials/4469/comparison-light.png?raw=true)

![First icon addition — dark background](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/bcbbe6d9ba46dc297a11fef8900bfa743c0be941/review-materials/4469/comparison-dark.png?raw=true)

### Render checks and limits

Desktop renderer recorded: `offscreen CPU Skia/painterResource` at `2026-10-02T17:40:58.064353846Z`. Source/final: Original 210x34 lockup vector verified: wordmark 'БАНК КУЗНЕЦКИЙ' plus fan emblem, all fills #069347, plain white canvas rect. Final contains only the emblem subset; emblem geometry verbatim \(uniform 0.75 scale + translation\), color and gaps preserved. Independent librsvg source reference \(240px canvas convention\) compared against final: identical emblem shapes; text correctly excluded.; base/final and rendering: First addition: no base icon exists at the frozen base commit \(baseline.present=false, baseIconHash null\), so base/final comparison is explicitly absent. Final render quality inspected in actual offscreen Compose Desktop frames on light and dark themes plus rsvg diagnostics at 48/96/272 px: whole emblem visible, no clipping, emblem reads clearly on both themes.

- android-compose: not-tested (available: false) — Android emulator runtime is unavailable in this environment \(no emulator binary, no installed system images, no AVDs\); creating images is outside this run..
- android-native: not-tested (available: false) — Android emulator runtime is unavailable in this environment \(only platform tools and SDK manager are installed\); the target remains untested..
- ios-compose: not-tested (available: false) — No iOS toolchain exists on this Linux host; the target remains untested..
- ios-native: not-tested (available: false) — No iOS toolchain exists on this Linux host; the target remains untested..

Desktop observation is for the generated XML through Compose Desktop `painterResource`, not a claim of successful Android/iOS or native-widget rendering. Unavailable targets remain untested; reviewer visual approval and merge remain separate decisions.
